# Angular Adapter — Mental Model

> Shared adapter facts (conformance, parity, bridge registries, event/feature wiring, shell-content wrappers) → adapters.md.

## vitest transform (vite 8 = rolldown/oxc)

- DECIDED (Jul 2026, #439): `libs/grid-angular/vitest.config.mts` MUST set `oxc: { decorator: { legacy: true } }`. WHY: vite 8 (`rolldown-vite`) transforms TS with **OXC, not esbuild**, and OXC does NOT read `experimentalDecorators` from tsconfig. Without the flag OXC treats `@Directive`/`@Component` as TC39-standard decorators and leaves them INLINE in the SSR module output; vite's import rewrite then mangles them into `@(0,__vite_ssr_import_0__.Directive)(...)` → every spec importing a decorated class dies at load with `SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token` (28 suites, 0 tests). RULED OUT: adding `experimentalDecorators` to tsconfig (OXC ignores it; grid-angular `tsconfig.json` has `include: []`); `esbuild.tsconfigRaw` (vite 8's `convertEsbuildConfigToOxcConfig` maps only jsx/define/banner/footer). Guard: the whole suite fails to load if removed.

## angular-grid-adapter

- OWNS: `viewRefs`, `componentRefs`, per-cell editor tracking. KEY FILES: `angular-grid-adapter.ts`, `angular-column-config.ts`, `inject-grid.ts`, `directives/grid.directive.ts`.
- BRIDGE: `createEmbeddedView(template, ctx)` + `syncRootNodes(viewRef, container)` — compares `viewRef.rootNodes` vs `container.childNodes` and replaces all if different (handles `@if`/`@for`).
- TENSION: two renderer syntaxes supported (`*tbwRenderer` structural directive vs nested `tbw-grid-column-view`). Registration requires manual DI setup (not auto like React/Vue).
- DECIDED (#256): `mountComponentRenderer<TCtx>(componentClass, mapInputs, pool)` is the canonical primitive for mounting a standalone component into a cell/header/panel, returning `{ hostElement, componentRef }`. All `createComponent*Renderer` methods are thin wrappers; the cell cache (WeakMap pool reuse) and editor wiring stay AROUND the primitive.
- DECIDED (May 2026): `mountComponentRenderer` and `createTrackedEmbeddedView<TCtx>(template, context)` are public `@internal` (typedoc-excluded) so feature secondary entries can mount user components without reaching into adapter privates. `setComponentInputs` stays private.
- DECIDED (PR #402, TemplateRef brand): feature secondary entries that mount templates MUST derive the `TemplateRef` type from a getter (`ReturnType<typeof getStructuralEditorTemplate>`), NOT a local `import type { TemplateRef } from '@angular/core'` — the local import resolves through Bun's `.bun/` cache during ng-packagr build → brand-incompatible `TemplateRef` vs the built adapter `.d.ts` (see build-and-deploy.md § dual-package hazard). INVARIANT: in `features/editing/src/index.ts` the cast target MUST be `ReturnType<typeof getStructuralEditorTemplate>` (its `StructuralEditorContext` has `any` defaults, so a generic `GridEditorContext<TValue, TRow>` stays bivariantly assignable at `createEditorTemplateView(template, context)` under `strictFunctionTypes`). RULED OUT: `ReturnType<typeof getEditorTemplate>` → `GridEditorContext<unknown, unknown>`, where `onCommit: (value: TValue) => void` is not assignable to `(value: unknown) => void` (TS2345, broke CI on PR #402).
- DECIDED (Jun 2026, filtering): secondary-entry filter-panel APIs MUST derive the params type from the adapter surface (`ReturnType<FilterPanel['params']>`) instead of importing `FilterPanelParams` from `@toolbox-web/grid/plugins/filtering`. WHY: ng-packagr/CI can resolve `@toolbox-web/grid` symbols from mixed physical roots, making structurally-equal generics brand-incompatible → TS2416/TS2345 on `BaseFilterPanel.params`.
- DECIDED (#427, lazy-form editor control): the template-editor bridge in `features/editing/src/index.ts` MUST resolve the `FormControl` via `getFormArrayContext(gridEl) ?? getLazyFormContext(gridEl)`. WHY: `GridFormArray` and `GridLazyForm` each store their `FormArrayContext` under a SEPARATE module-local `Symbol('formArrayContext')` (NOT shared, despite the comment) — checking only `getFormArrayContext` silently returns `undefined` for a `[lazyForm]` grid, so a control-based editor shows its fallback value. INVARIANT: creating the lazy FormGroup (via `getControl`) on editor mount ALSO activates `GridLazyForm.#handleRowCommit` — if that FormGroup is invalid it calls `event.preventDefault()` and core REVERTS the whole row (and skips the FormGroup delete, leaving a stale cached group). So an over-strict validator in the consumer's `lazyForm` factory blocks EVERY commit for that row, not just the offending field.
- INVARIANT (`gridConfig.features` renderer bridging): `processConfig` (the `set gridConfig` interceptor) MUST run `getFeatureConfigPreprocessor(name)` over every `gridConfig.features.<name>` object, exactly as it bridges `columns`/`typeDefaults`/`loadingRenderer`/`emptyRenderer`. WHY: component-class renderers supplied via `gridConfig.features` otherwise reach the core plugin factory raw → `TypeError: Class constructor … cannot be invoked without 'new'` at afterRender. The directive-input path bridges these in `createFeaturePlugins`; the `gridConfig.features` path was the parity gap. Idempotent; booleans/non-objects skipped. Test: `angular-grid-adapter.spec.ts` "bridges a component-class groupHeaderRenderer inside gridConfig.features.groupingColumns".

## event payload contract (camelCase output = UNWRAPPED detail)

- INVARIANT: Angular camelCase outputs (`(cellClick)`, `(cellCommit)`, …) emit the **unwrapped `*Detail`**, NOT the native `CustomEvent` — `Grid.setupEventListeners` does `this[outputName].emit((e as CustomEvent).detail)` and outputs are typed `output<CellClickDetail<any>>()`. So `$event.value`, NOT `$event.detail.value`. Same contract as React `EventHandler<T>`. To get the native `CustomEvent` (for `preventDefault()`), bind KEBAB-case (`(cell-commit)`). Vue `@event` always delivers the native `CustomEvent`. Docs have drifted here before — the directive code is authoritative.

## per-feature directives (v3.0.0, #260)

- DECIDED (May 2026): each plugin's `[input]`/`(output)` lives in an attribute-selector directive `features/<name>/src/grid-<name>.directive.ts` (e.g. `selector: 'tbw-grid[filtering], tbw-grid[filterChange]'`). WHY: every `input()`/`output()` on `Grid` ships `ɵɵdefineDirective` metadata into core whether imported or not. BONUS: compile-time guarantee (`Can't bind to 'filtering' since it isn't a known property of 'tbw-grid'`) — STRONGER than React/Vue (silent drop) and WC core (runtime throw). RULED OUT: Angular `hostDirectives` (static metadata bakes into `Grid.ɵɵdefineDirective`, breaks tree-shake); side-effect auto-registration (the standalone compiler resolves statically from the consumer's `imports`).
- DECIDED (v3.0.0, #260): the deprecated per-feature `Grid` inputs/outputs are REMOVED. `Grid` now declares ONLY the core surface — input `gridConfig`; outputs `cellClick`, `rowClick`, `cellActivate`, `cellChange`, `dataChange`, `sortChange`, `columnResize`, `columnResizeReset`, `columnStateChange`, `tbwScroll`, `render` — plus `TbwRenderer`. `peerDependencies."@toolbox-web/grid"` = `^3.0.0-beta` (see release-versioning.md #411).
- DECIDED (claims registry = sole source): `src/lib/internal/feature-claims.ts` holds per-element claims (`WeakMap<HTMLElement, Map<name, configGetter>>` + `WeakMap<HTMLElement, Set<eventName>>`). Directive ctor calls `registerFeatureClaim(grid, name, () => this.input())` + `claimEvent(grid, eventName)`; `Grid.createFeaturePlugins` reads config ONLY from `getFeatureClaim(...)?.()`; `Grid.setupEventListeners` skips `isEventClaimed`. Reading the getter inside an effect transitively tracks the directive's signal — all directives at a node construct before any `effect()` (microtask). `ngOnDestroy` calls `unregister*`. The pre-v3 "directive wins / `(filterChange)` goes silent" asymmetry is GONE.
- DECIDED: `gridConfig.features` and per-feature directives COMPOSE. When a directive matches via event-only binding (`<tbw-grid (filterChange)="…"/>` without `[filtering]`), `registerFeatureClaim` returns `undefined` → `createFeaturePlugins` skips → core's `createPluginsFromFeatures` creates the plugin → the directive's `addEventListener('filter-change')` still fires.
- INVARIANT: every feature MUST appear as `addPlugin('<name>')` in `Grid.createFeaturePlugins`, else its directive sets a claim nobody reads. Also append `export type { _Augmentation as _<Name>Augmentation } from '@toolbox-web/grid/features/<name>';` to `lib/internal/feature-augmentations.ts`.
- INVARIANT (event coverage guard): removing an output from `eventOutputMap` REQUIRES adding its DOM event name to the `_intentionallyOmittedEvents` union in `grid.directive.ts`, else `_assertEventOutputMapCoversCore` fails the build. As of v3 that union lists the 31 feature-owned DOM events now surfaced by per-feature directives.
- DECIDED (Feb 2026): `_assertEventOutputMapCoversCore` MUST be `private readonly … = true`, NEVER `declare private …` — a `declare`d property is only a type annotation, so the guard was inert from introduction until Feb 2026 and 7 events drifted in unnoticed. Assigning `true` is what forces the conditional to collapse. Same trap as React's `_featurePropsCoverCore`. Verify by deleting one union member — you must get `Type 'boolean' is not assignable to type ['Missing Angular outputs…', '<event>']`.
- DECIDED (v3.4.0): the former "known adapter gaps" bucket is closed. `baselines-captured` is surfaced by `GridEditingDirective` as `(baselinesCaptured)` (React `onBaselinesCaptured`, Vue `@baselines-captured`). `tree-load-start`/`tree-load-end`/`tree-load-error` became real in v3.4.0 — React/Vue surface them; Angular keeps them in `_intentionallyOmittedEvents` for the same reason as `tree-expand` (no tree directive yet → consumers use `addEventListener`). `mount-external-editor`/`mount-external-view`/`column-reorder-request` are correctly omitted (internal plumbing).
- INVARIANT (shell augmentation): `grid-header-content.directive.ts` + `grid-toolbar-content.directive.ts` MUST keep `import type {} from '@toolbox-web/grid/plugins/shell';` — it activates the `PluginNameMap['shell']` augmentation so `grid.getPluginByName('shell')?.register{Header,Toolbar}Content(…)` type-checks. DO NOT delete as "unused": it compiled green in v2 only via the transitive augmentation from auto-imported shell; at v3 the shell is tree-shaken out of core and the augmentation vanishes → TS error on `GridPlugin`. Tests cannot catch its removal. REGRESSED in #382 (import dropped, comment kept); restored in #383 — the comment without the import is a red flag.
- TENSION: claims-registry helpers must be re-exported from the package barrel (ng-packagr forbids relative secondary→primary), are `@internal`/typedoc-excluded, and cannot be tree-shaken out for zero-feature-directive consumers.

### Directive selector / event ownership

| Directive (`Grid<Name>Directive`) | Selector input                                           | Owned events                                                                                                                                           |
| --------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| selection                         | `[selection]`                                            | `selection-change`                                                                                                                                     |
| editing                           | `[editing]`                                              | `cell-commit`, `cell-cancel`, `row-commit`, `changed-rows-reset`, `edit-open`, `before-edit-close`, `edit-close`, `dirty-change`, `baselines-captured` |
| clipboard                         | `[clipboard]`                                            | `copy`, `paste`                                                                                                                                        |
| contextMenu                       | `[contextMenu]`                                          | `context-menu-open`                                                                                                                                    |
| multiSort                         | `[multiSort]`                                            | — (`sort-change` stays on `Grid`; single-column sort emits without the plugin)                                                                         |
| reorderColumns                    | `[reorderColumns]`                                       | `column-move`                                                                                                                                          |
| visibility                        | `[visibility]`                                           | `column-visibility` (`columnStateChange` stays on `Grid` — multi-source)                                                                               |
| pinnedColumns                     | `[pinnedColumns]`                                        | —                                                                                                                                                      |
| groupingColumns                   | `[groupingColumns]`                                      | —                                                                                                                                                      |
| columnVirtualization              | `[columnVirtualization]`                                 | —                                                                                                                                                      |
| reorderRows                       | `[reorderRows]`                                          | — (alias of rowDragDrop; events owned there to avoid duplicate listeners)                                                                              |
| rowDragDrop                       | `[rowDragDrop]`                                          | `row-move`, `row-drag-start`, `row-drag-end`, `row-drop`, `row-transfer`                                                                               |
| groupingRows                      | `[groupingRows]`                                         | `group-toggle`, `group-expand`, `group-collapse`                                                                                                       |
| pinnedRows                        | `[pinnedRows]`                                           | —                                                                                                                                                      |
| tree                              | `[tree]`                                                 | `tree-expand`                                                                                                                                          |
| masterDetail                      | `[masterDetail]`                                         | `detail-expand`                                                                                                                                        |
| responsive                        | `[responsive]`                                           | `responsive-change`                                                                                                                                    |
| undoRedo                          | `[undoRedo]`                                             | `undo`, `redo`                                                                                                                                         |
| export                            | `[export]` (TS field `exportFeature`, `alias: 'export'`) | `export-complete`                                                                                                                                      |
| print                             | `[print]`                                                | `print-start`, `print-complete`                                                                                                                        |
| pivot                             | `[pivot]`                                                | —                                                                                                                                                      |
| serverSide                        | `[serverSide]`                                           | —                                                                                                                                                      |
| stickyRows                        | `[stickyRows]`                                           | —                                                                                                                                                      |
| tooltip                           | `[tooltip]`                                              | —                                                                                                                                                      |

- STAYS ON `Grid`: `cellChange`, `dataChange` (non-editing paths also emit); `sort-change`, `columnStateChange` (multi-source aggregates).
- NOTE: `CellCommitEvent`/`RowCommitEvent` interfaces are still DEFINED and exported from `grid.directive.ts` (public API consumed by `GridEditingDirective`), which owns the `(cellCommit)`/`(rowCommit)` outputs.

## overlay editors (`BaseOverlayEditor`)

- OWNS: the panel element (moved to `document.body` to escape grid overflow clipping) and `_abortCtrl: AbortController` for all listeners.
- DISMISSAL (all call abstract `onOverlayOutsideClick()`; the subclass decides commit vs cancel): `pointerdown` outside panel+host; `tbw-scroll` on the closest `<tbw-grid>`; the cell losing `cell-focus` via MutationObserver → `hideOverlay()` (cancel path).
- INVARIANT: all listeners share `_abortCtrl.signal` — `teardownOverlay()` aborts them at once. Handlers guard on `_isOpen && _panel` (listeners attach eagerly in `initOverlay()`).
- DECIDED (#234): scroll → DISMISS, not reposition (matches click-outside semantics, consumes the public `tbw-scroll`).
- TENSION: anchor positioning uses CSS Anchor (`anchor-name`) when supported, else `_positionWithJs()` (only on open).

## CVA editors (`BaseGridEditorCVA`)

- INVARIANT: `displayValue` precedence = `_committed` → `currentValue()` → `cvaValue()`. `commitBoth()` sets `_committed = { value }` (wrapped so a committed `null` stays distinguishable); `onExternalValueChange()` (grid) and `writeValue()` (form) clear it. Subclasses overriding `onExternalValueChange()` MUST call `super` or it is never discarded.
- DECIDED (2026-02): an editor's own commit outranks its `value` input. WHY: `EditingPlugin`'s `cell-change` listener does `if (source === 'user') return;`, so the grid never echoes a cell's own commit back; in `editing.config.mode === 'row'` editors stay mounted and the input goes permanently stale — normalising editors (day number → full date) reverted on tab-out and re-committed the stale value. `base-grid-editor-cva.ts` / `base-grid-editor-cva.spec.ts`.
- RULED OUT: dropping the plugin's `source === 'user'` skip — it deliberately avoids clobbering in-progress typing in the originating editor.
- INVARIANT: cell-cancel / cascade / undo-redo reach the editor through `EditingPlugin`'s `#editorValueCallbacks` directly (not the `cell-change` listener), so they bypass the `source === 'user'` skip and do clear `_committed`.
- INVARIANT: precedence lives in the exported-but-not-barrelled `resolveEditorDisplayValue()` so it is unit-testable — this package avoids TestBed, so `BaseGridEditor` field initializers (`inject()`/`input()`) cannot run in specs.
- TENSION: a direct `control.setValue()` in FormArray mode clears neither path (no `cell-change`, and `[control]` is a plain input, not an `NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR` binding, so no `writeValue`), so `_committed` can shadow it.

## feature bridges

- DECIDED: Angular `registerTemplateBridge` callbacks (master-detail, responsive) MUST look up via `(grid as any).getPluginByName?.(name)`, NOT scan `gridConfig.plugins` — feature-resolver plugins live only in `PluginManager`, so scanning `gridConfig.plugins.find(...)` emitted spurious "is not configured" warnings.
- INVARIANT: `angular-grid-adapter.spec.ts` registers bridges/preprocessors INLINE in `beforeAll` from `./internal/feature-bridges` and `./internal/feature-extensions` — NOT via a barrel side-effect import (that would define `tbw-grid` and trip ResizeObserver in jsdom).
- INVARIANT: feature secondary VALUE imports MUST go through the `@toolbox-web/grid-angular` barrel, NOT relative `../../../src/lib/...` — ng-packagr fails `TS6059: File … is not under 'rootDir'` (template typecheck generates `.ngtypecheck.ts` outside the secondary's rootDir). Type-only imports may use relative paths.

## testing

- INVARIANT: this project deliberately avoids `TestBed` — bootstrapping platform-browser-dynamic adds 3–5 s per spec file and is unnecessary for component-free logic.
- PATTERN: for `inject()`-constructed classes (`GridTypeRegistry`, `BaseOverlayEditor`), instantiate without the ctor via `Object.create(MyClass.prototype)` and seed private fields.
- PATTERN: for `AngularGridAdapter`, mock `createComponent` from `@angular/core` plus the seven template-registry getter modules (`./directives/grid-detail-view.directive`, `grid-responsive-card.directive`, `grid-tool-panel.directive`, `grid-column-view.directive`, `grid-column-editor.directive`, `structural-directives`, `./grid-type-registry`). The mocked `createComponent` MUST write its `hostElement` option onto `componentRef.location.nativeElement` so the adapter's `cellEl.contains(...)` cleanup checks succeed.
- PATTERN: for directives using `inject()` + `effect()` + `input()` field initialisers (e.g. `GridFormArray`), `vi.mock('@angular/core', …)` to replace the three primitives. Full recipe in [testing-patterns.instructions.md](../instructions/testing-patterns.instructions.md).
- INVARIANT: `angular-grid-adapter.conformance.spec.ts` MUST start with `import '@angular/compiler';` (the adapter transitively imports partially-compiled `@angular/forms`) and use `GridAdapter.prototype` because the ctor requires DI.
- DECIDED (#237): with V8 coverage only LOADED files appear in the denominator — adding `import { GridAdapter }` to a conformance spec dropped grid-angular from ~80 % to ~33 %. The restoration path is real unit tests using the patterns above, NOT a lowered threshold or an exclude. `grid.directive.ts` (1581 lines) is intentionally NOT unit-tested — it is covered end-to-end by the demo apps and Playwright; importing it would double the V8-visible project size.

## ng-packagr secondary-entry rules

- INVARIANT: ng-packagr 21 forbids primary depending on secondary. Direction is secondary → primary ONLY. This blocks "physically move the directive into the feature folder, then re-export from the main barrel".
- INVARIANT: NEVER re-export a directive via a relative path (`export { GridDetailView } from '../features/master-detail/src/...'`) — it emits the file into BOTH bundles → two directive classes, two registries, cross-bundle bridge breaks at runtime.
- DECIDED: feature-specific directives that cannot move yet (e.g. `GridDetailView`) use soft-deprecation — source stays in `src/lib/directives/`, the main `index.ts` re-exports it with a `MOVE-IN-V2:` marker (NOT `@deprecated`, which would warn correct-feature consumers), and the feature entry re-exports from `@toolbox-web/grid-angular` so the canonical path works. Physical move is queued in release-versioning.md § v3.0.0 cleanup plan.

## tsconfig paths & typedoc

- INVARIANT: the `tsconfig.base.json` mappings `@toolbox-web/grid-angular` → `dist/libs/grid-angular/index.d.ts` and `.../features/*` → `dist/libs/grid-angular/features/*.d.ts` are STALE — ng-packagr 21 emits to `dist/libs/grid-angular/types/…`. Broken since the ng-packagr migration (`5a6f3fb4`); most consumers do not notice because they read sources via project references or `package.json#exports` at runtime. Do NOT "fix" the global mapping without auditing every typecheck/typedoc/build target — several work BECAUSE the mapping resolves to nothing.
- DECIDED: `libs/grid-angular/tsconfig.typedoc.json` overrides `paths` to point at SOURCE (`./src/index.ts`, `./features/*/src/index.ts`) so typedoc never depends on built dist; without it typedoc fails with 30+ TS2307 cascades. Mirror this for any future "read source across the primary/secondary boundary" tooling.

## bundle-size gotchas

- INVARIANT: `feature-augmentations.ts` MUST use `//` line comments only, NEVER JSDoc (`/** */`). ng-packagr's fesm is unminified, so terser preserves every JSDoc block verbatim — a 28-line JSDoc header in that one file added ~1500 B to `fesm2022/toolbox-web-grid-angular.mjs` and pushed the bundle 223 B over its 276 480-byte budget.
- RULED OUT (`FeatureName` derivation): `import type {} from '@toolbox-web/grid/features/<name>'` — Prettier and `organize-imports` strip empty-brace imports as unused, so the file ends up containing only its `//` header, `FeatureName` collapses to `never`, and every `addPlugin('selection', …)` fails TS2345. Named type re-exports survive formatters because they have a real exported binding.

## column shorthand

- DECIDED (#276): the shorthand helpers (`parseColumnShorthand`/`normalizeColumns`/`hasColumnShorthands`/`applyColumnDefaults` + type `ColumnShorthand`) moved to core `core/internal/column-shorthand.ts` and are exported from `public.ts`. grid-angular's `column-shorthand.ts` is now a THIN RE-EXPORT from `@toolbox-web/grid` — Angular never consumed them internally and its shorthand API already typed against core `ColumnConfig`, so the re-export is type-identical. Only React keeps typed wrappers (widened `ColumnConfig`).
